resources.string: Keeps the suggestion overlay running while you play
Tap the bubble to analyse. You place the pieces.
Android only lets an app draw on top of other apps if you switch this on yourself. You will be sent to the system Settings screen - nothing is installed and nothing is changed except this one switch.

Android shows its own screen-capture dialog. Choose Block Blast and tap "Start recording". Each frame is analysed in memory and immediately thrown away. Nothing is stored, and this app contains no network code at all.
Android 13 and newer needs your permission before an app can show a notification. This app only ever shows one, to let you stop the overlay. It never sends a message.
